Brewpub Simulator announced – new game coming to Steam!

Quit your day job, open a bar! 

We’re celebrating International Beer Day (yes, we know it’s tomorrow) with a new game about crafting beer!

Brew lagers, stouts and IPAs, and serve patrons at your own brewpub. Decorate the place, create your own brands of beer, and expand into the best joint in town. All of this in a relaxing simulator that values creativity and passion for crafting.

notes.title: How you can support indie devs?
Holiday Poetry Contest & a Grand Prize!
notes.content:
Hello there! 

We have a very exciting challenge for you. We’re astounded by the beautiful pieces of art and poetry you’re sending our way, so we decided to make a contest out of it!

Send us a poem inspired by the Lust Universe and the poem most liked by the community (and us) will win the contest.

We know you’ll certainly deliver and we have a great prize to offer!

*Drums*

[b]THE WINNING POEM WILL BE READ AND RECORDED BY AMANDA HERSELF – THE WONDERFUL OLIVIA STEELE[/b]

Yes! Olivia Steele graciously agreed to lend us her voice once more as Amanda and record the poems which wins the contest. Watch our recent Q&A with Olivia:

[previewyoutube=V5puZkOTK10;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=XvrUAC9FHAs;full][/previewyoutube]

Here are some rules:

[list]
[*] The poem you enter into the contest must be written by you;
[*] We also accept poems published by us before. Just let us know you want them included in the contest;
[*] Only one poem in a written form;
[*] Poem should be written in English;
[*] No restrictions on the length, but please keep it sensible;
[*] During the voting stage, please don’t vote for yourself.
[/list]

Send us your poems to fanart@moviegames.pl with an “LFB Holiday Poem Contest Entry” subject line before the 31st of December 2021. Don’t forget to sign your work!

After the New Year, we will conduct a preselection and then post your works on social media for the community to cast their vote on. The poem with the most votes wins and will be recorded by Olivia in the following weeks.

Ready your pens or quills, the contest is on! Good luck.

notes.title: Book Recommendations from Beyond
notes.content:
[h3]Hi there, Cultists![/h3]
For some time now we’ve been sharing our weekly reading recommendations with our fans on [url=https://discord.gg/3GxnHEX7md]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/MGLunarium]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/LustFromBeyond]Facebook[/url]. We’d like to share them here with you as well. The stories below have inspired us greatly, and we hope you’ll like them as well. Enjoy!



[h2]The King in Yellow[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723213/279cbbaee8e158267a8f0b89daa16f1f57fba7b4.jpg[/img]

This is where esoteric horror really started. Chambers’s tales, focused around a book that inspired madness, had a huge influence on Lovecraft. They also were referenced heavily in the first season of True Detective. It’s A MUST-READ!


[h2]Providence[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723213/056f421eecea6fb3e6b20e7f67ba2de5d0750ba4.jpg[/img]

Not just any Providence. Alan Moore’s PROVIDENCE! It’s a highly controversial graphic novel that orbits around H.P. Lovecraft and his mythos. If you dig the lore, every page is chock full of references. It’s also a complex, compelling and at times shocking story that intertwines with Moore’s two other books. But, we’ll let you discover that for yourself.


[h2]The Murders in the Rue Morgue[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723213/4ba7fafad7a2ab572dc845d396d0ec91da3b0058.jpg[/img]

Looking for a mystery dripping with atmosphere? Then you just have to pick up Edgar Allan Poe's The Murders in the Rue Morgue. Or rather all Poe's stories about Dupin, who was basically a different version of Sherlock Holmes. There's gore, there are dark secrets, and... we just feel you're gonna like it.


Did you like any of the books we recommended? Review them in the comments or share your recommendations!
